systems.name: Iowa Public Employees' Retirement System

statute.quote: The “Iowa Public Employees’ Retirement System” is established as an independent agency within the executive branch of state government.

body.name: Iowa Public Employees' Retirement System (independent agency; investment board under 97B.8A)

source.quote: The Iowa public employees’ retirement system shall administer the retirement system established under this chapter.

website_source.quote: Iowa Public Employees' Retirement System 7401 Register Drive P.O. Box 9117 Des Moines, IA 50306-9117 Phone 515-281-0020

covers_local_source.quote: “Employer” means the state of Iowa, the counties, municipalities, agencies, public school districts, all political subdivisions, and all of their departments and instrumentalities,

systems.notes: Covers state, county, city and school district employees, including teachers. Website quote is the agency's address block.

systems.name: Municipal Fire and Police Retirement System of Iowa

statute.quote: Effective January 1, 1992, a single statewide fire and police retirement system is established to replace the individual city fire retirement systems and police retirement systems operating under this chapter prior to that date.

body.name: Board of trustees for the statewide fire and police retirement system

source.quote: A board of trustees for the statewide fire and police retirement system is created.

website_source.quote: Municipal Fire and Police Retirement System provides pension benefits for municipal police officers and fire fighters in Iowa.

covers_local_source.quote: Each city fire retirement system and police retirement system operating under this chapter prior to May 3, 1990, shall participate in the statewide system.

systems.name: Iowa Department of Public Safety Peace Officers' Retirement, Accident, and Disability System

statute.quote: The Iowa department of public safety peace officers’ retirement, accident, and disability system is created.

body.name: Board of trustees of the peace officers' retirement system

source.quote: The system shall be administered under the direction of the board of trustees, and shall transact all of its business, invest all of its funds,

systems.notes: Covers peace officers of the Iowa Department of Public Safety. Official web page not confirmed.
